body:
The Tide Clock text on the board came from the live install test of 11-20: its made-up project was a branch of the kit's own repository, so its first board sync landed in the kit's real board copy. From now on a test run refuses any write to a board, a board copy or a remote that is not in a temp folder, and says which path it refused. The orchestrator's post now describes this repository again, with its session kept.

### How the Tide Clock text got onto the real board
- `origin/board-mirror` begins with commit 738a5f3 (2026-11-20 02:51Z, "kit sync ... (full)"), which adds `_orchestrator` ("the install session of the board kit on Tide Clock (branch test-install)") and `KIT-installed`.
- `origin/test-install` is an orphan branch of anlonlt/board made at 02:48Z for the install test BD10: "Test project for the kit's install: a tiny tide clock". Its install commit at 02:50Z names another board (Etco5hYbtiiSHtV53saYB7) but keeps the mirror branch name `board-mirror`.
- The mirror branch is one per repository, not per branch: the test project's `kit sync --commit` + `kit push` from a clone of anlonlt/board created the kit's own board-mirror. The real board then grew on top of it, and the `_orchestrator` post was never rewritten.
- So it was not a Python test with a fallen-back URL but a live install test with no temp folder and no test mark. No unit test wrote there (the full suite now runs with the guard and nothing is refused).

### What refuses now (kit/test_guard.py, installed as .kit/test_guard.py)
In a test run (`KIT_TEST` set; run_all_tests.py sets it for every suite):
- every `git` command a kit script starts goes through a check first: a commit, merge, push, pull, rebase, reset... in a repository outside a temp folder is refused, and a push must go to a local folder under a temp folder (never github.com);
- kit.py's sync, sync-db and init refuse a board copy (mirror) outside a temp folder, before writing a file;
- a board server refuses to open a data folder outside a temp folder;
- board_cli and kit.py refuse an HTTP write to a board server unless its health says its data is a test's (`"temp": true`, only ever true for a server started in a test run, under a temp folder; the real board always says no and the path is never shown). The default URL fallback (127.0.0.1:8765, the real board) is therefore refused whether it runs or not.
Each refusal reads `KIT_TEST: REFUSED: a test run writes ... outside a temp folder: <path or URL>`. Scripts that load it: kit.py, board_server.py, board_cli.py, end_session.py, web_takeover.py. Outside a test run it is not even loaded.

### The orchestrator post
`_orchestrator` now reads: "Orchestrator of the board kit's own repository (anlonlt/board): it reads the board, launches each step as a part on its own branch, merges what is reviewed and answers the owner here. Start it with `python3 -I .kit/kit.py resume --role orchestrator`." Its session id (session_01AE1HGgfX1UjBPPJLiaUHxW, the Artifact's) and created_at are kept.

### The test
tests/test_cl48_test_guard.py, in a test run: kit.py init on the real `../board-mirror` is refused with its path and creates nothing; kit.py push to https://github.com/anlonlt/board.git is refused with the URL; a board_cli write to a board server started outside a test run (the real board's stand-in) is refused and the post does not exist after; board_cli with no URL (the real board's default) is refused; a board server on the repository's own data is refused with `.kit/board_data`. The same push to a temp bare repository and the same write to a test's board go through.
handoff: A test run is KIT_TEST=1 (run_all_tests.py sets it, with KIT_TEST_GUARD pointing at kit/test_guard.py for tests that copy a few scripts by hand). A live install test by an agent should export KIT_TEST=1 and use a temp folder for its project. A new script that writes to a board, a mirror or a remote loads the guard with the same 20-line _test_guard() as kit.py.
not_checked: A live install test run by an agent (like BD10) is covered only if KIT_TEST is set in that session: nothing marks such a run as a test by itself.
Writes the agent makes itself with ArtifactData (the claude.ai board) are not scripts and are not guarded; kit's scripts only build the batch.
The board-mirror history still starts with the Tide Clock commit 738a5f3; it is not rewritten (the post's text is corrected instead).
tests/test_train_and_task_train.py fails here outside the runner (it reads this session's half-loaded Artifact copy, "never loaded"), the same before this change; it passes in run_all_tests.
